title: Mean time to remediate — blocklist propagation
summary: Time between the playbook accepting a normalised indicator above the confidence threshold and the blocklist-propagation step completing across the operator's enforcement points (network / DNS / EDR). Measures the response loop the playbook owns end-to-end, independent of upstream feed delay. Lower is better.

target.rationale: Operator target derived from D3FEND D3-ITF / D3-OTF / D3-DNSDL guidance — perimeter and DNS denylisting are typically reload-or-API-call workloads completable inside fifteen minutes.

measurement.formula: mean( propagate_to_blocklist.completed_at - if_above_confidence.completed_at ) over playbook runs where the if-condition evaluated true, within the window.

inputs.name: playbook_run
inputs.description: duration from confidence-gate completion to blocklist-propagation completion

external_refs.name: MITRE D3FEND v1.0.0 — D3-ITF / D3-OTF / D3-DNSDL
